routes.native: Pinned WebCore SVG classes and their existing reference-counted value/list implementations.
routes.browser: Actual browser SVG DOM operations through generated structural interfaces. Measured Chromium156 returns SVGMatrix and SVGPoint objects. Three dictionary-based transform operations normalize with DOMMatrix.fromMatrix, create a genuine SVGMatrix and copy coefficients before invoking the actual receiver method.
routes.svgMatrix: SVGMatrix double coefficients; never reinterpret a native SVGMatrix pointer as DOMMatrix.
routes.svgPointAndRect: Pinned float fields; preserve precision rather than promise unrestricted doubles.
routes.incidentalRootMembers: Selecting SVGSVGElement also binds root view/animation members. Their S06/S07 acceptance remains separate.
routes.supportingTextMembers: SVGTextPositioningElement supplies actual length/number list instances; incidental text metrics do not close S05.
routes.supportingPointMembers: SVGPolygonElement/SVGPolylineElement supply points and animatedPoints; this does not close S03 shape reflection.
routes.numericInputs: Selected SVG restricted float/double scalar inputs reject nonfinite values before mutation. Native DOMMatrix2DInit fields remain unrestricted.
routes.browserDictionaryLimit: The three browser dictionary adapters cannot copy nonfinite coefficients through restricted SVGMatrix setters and throw TypeError; native dictionaries preserve NaN/Infinity. This is an explicit measured route limitation, not global DOMMatrix dictionary narrowing.
